# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(mgcv)
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_phenotype.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
methyl_phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props.rds"))
```

```{r}
rwh_phenotype <- methyl_phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(sample_id), ! is.na(ever_pregnant))
```


# Prepare counts

For visualisation purposes, remove batch effect

```{r}
exprs <- GSE234354_counts[GSE234354_gene_annotations$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id]
ok <- rowMeans(cpm(exprs) > 0.5) > 0.2
# table(ok)
gene_annotation <- GSE234354_gene_annotations[ok,]

y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts[gene_annotation$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id], 
             genes=gene_annotation)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
nc <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)
```

```{r}
covariates <- model.matrix(~ rna_batch, data=rwh_phenotype)
nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# # Functionally the same as using the batch argument, but intercept for each 
# # gene is slightly different
# nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, batch=rwh_phenotype$rna_batch)
```

-----

# PCA

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(nc_bc[,rwh_phenotype$sample_id]))
dat <- cbind(rwh_phenotype, pca$x[,1:5])
```

```{r}
head(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 10)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, colour=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradientn(limits=c(0,100), colors=rainbow(20)[2:19], name="Cycle Time") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(rwh_phenotype$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
covariates <- model.matrix(~ X)
nc_cc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc_bc, covariates=covariates[,-1])
```

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(nc_cc[,rwh_phenotype$sample_id]))
dat <- cbind(rwh_phenotype, pca$x[,1:5])
```

```{r}
head(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 10)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, colour=cl_epithelial)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colors=topo.colors(20)[5:20]) +
  theme_bw()
```


-----

# Variance explained

## Model 0

```{r}
mod_0 <- lm(t(nc_bc) ~ cycle_phase, data=rwh_phenotype)
mod_0_r2 <- t(sapply(summary(mod_0), \(x) {c(r.squared=x$r.squared, adj.r.squared=x$adj.r.squared)}))
mean(mod_0_r2[,2])
```


## Model 1

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(rwh_phenotype$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
mod_1 <- lm(t(nc_bc) ~ X, data=rwh_phenotype)
mod_1_r2 <- t(sapply(summary(mod_1), \(x) {c(r.squared=x$r.squared, adj.r.squared=x$adj.r.squared)}))
mean(mod_1_r2[,2])
```

## Model 2

```{r}
mod_2 <- lm(t(nc_bc) ~ cl_epithelial + cl_immune + cl_mesenchymal, data=rwh_phenotype)
mod_2_r2 <- t(sapply(summary(mod_2), \(x) {c(r.squared=x$r.squared, adj.r.squared=x$adj.r.squared)}))
mean(mod_2_r2[,2])
```

## Model 3

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(rwh_phenotype$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
mod_3 <- lm(t(nc_bc) ~ X + cl_epithelial + cl_immune + cl_mesenchymal, data=rwh_phenotype)
mod_3_r2 <- t(sapply(summary(mod_3), \(x) {c(r.squared=x$r.squared, adj.r.squared=x$adj.r.squared)}))
mean(mod_3_r2[,2])
```

## Compare models

```{r}
r2_df <- data.frame(mod_0=mod_0_r2[,"r.squared"],
                    mod_1=mod_1_r2[,"r.squared"],
                    mod_2=mod_2_r2[,"r.squared"],
                    mod_3=mod_3_r2[,"r.squared"])
rownames(r2_df) <- rownames(nc)
r2_df[1:5,]
```

```{r}
colMeans(r2_df)
```

```{r}
apply(r2_df, 1, which.max) %>% table()
```

```{r}
adj_r2_df <- data.frame(mod_0=mod_0_r2[,"adj.r.squared"],
                        mod_1=mod_1_r2[,"adj.r.squared"],
                        mod_2=mod_2_r2[,"adj.r.squared"],
                        mod_3=mod_3_r2[,"adj.r.squared"])
rownames(adj_r2_df) <- rownames(nc)
adj_r2_df[1:5,]
```

```{r}
colMeans(adj_r2_df)
```


```{r}
apply(adj_r2_df, 1, which.max) %>% table()
```


```{r}
dat <- adj_r2_df %>% rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=mod_0:mod_3, names_to="model", values_to="adj_R_squared")
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x=model, y=adj_R_squared)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,by=0.2)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title="Adjusted R-squared from RNA-seq (19k genes)")
```


# Output

## R2 stats

```{r}
mod_summary <- data.frame(mean=apply(r2_df, 2, mean),
                     t(apply(r2_df, 2, quantile, c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)))) %>%
  round(4)
mod_summary
```

```{r}
colnames(mod_summary) <- colnames(mod_summary) %>% 
  str_replace("\\.$", "_percentile") %>%
  str_remove("^X")
models <- c("~ cycle_phase",
            "~ cycle_time",
            "~ cell_lineages",
            "~ cycle_time + cell_lineages")
mod_summary$model_covariates <- models
```

```{r}
mod_summary
```

```{r}
write.table(mod_summary, file=here("outputs/rna_var_explained_r2.tsv"), sep="\t",
            quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
```

## Adj R2 stats

```{r}
mod_summary <- data.frame(mean=apply(adj_r2_df, 2, mean),
                     t(apply(adj_r2_df, 2, quantile, c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)))) %>%
  round(4)
mod_summary
```

```{r}
colnames(mod_summary) <- colnames(mod_summary) %>% 
  str_replace("\\.$", "_percentile") %>%
  str_remove("^X")
models <- c("~ cycle_phase",
            "~ cycle_time",
            "~ cell_lineages",
            "~ cycle_time + cell_lineages")
mod_summary$model_covariates <- models
```

```{r}
mod_summary
```

```{r}
write.table(mod_summary, file=here("outputs/rna_var_explained_adj_r2.tsv"), sep="\t",
            quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
```
